name: SRIKANTH YADUGANI
title: ==TEAM LEAD, QUALITY ASSURANCE==  |  QA AUTOMATION & RELEASE DELIVERY

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Quality Assurance Lead== with 15+ years of experience across software testing, automation and release delivery in financial services and retirement products. Leads work across the STLC, mentoring QA colleagues and coordinating release readiness. Hands-on with Java, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, SQL, Postman and CI pipelines; contributed to migrating existing automation capabilities to an Axiom-based Playwright/TypeScript framework.

roles.title: Lead QA Software Engineer | progression from Trainee and Software Tester
roles.meta: February 2011 - September 2026 | Financial Services and Retirement
bullets: Led QA activities across the STLC, translating project and client requirements into test scenarios, test cases, estimates and execution plans.
Planned and executed in-sprint automation for release stories; prepared test data, ran tests, triaged defects, retested fixes and published X-Ray results.
Automated sprint requirements with Selenium WebDriver, Java and Cucumber/BDD, then incorporated completed scripts into the regression suite.
Scheduled weekly regression runs through GitLab and GitHub Pipelines; configured Jenkins jobs and Windows Task Scheduler executions.
Enhanced Selenium frameworks and automation utilities for plan-health reports, PDF comparison, CCD Scrubber and CCD Splitter; validated report data with SQL.
Contributed to migrating existing framework capabilities to the Axiom automation framework using Playwright libraries and TypeScript.
Coordinated branch merges, Jenkins builds, Veracode scans and QA/Production deployments; mentored colleagues and communicated release risks and test status.

roles.title: Lead QA Engineer / Senior Quality Analyst
roles.meta: 2015 - September 2026 | Project team: 9 | Retirement and financial communications
bullets: Supported document composition, data integration and delivery of personalized retirement and financial communications across print, email and online channels.
Worked with Selenium, Java, TurboTest BDD/Cucumber, Vega, Axiom, SQL, Postman, FTP, PDFBox and Maven for automation and validation.
Client organizations included Nationwide, MissionSquare, T. Rowe Price, Equitable, LPL, American Funds, DFA and Security Benefit.

roles.title: Quality Analyst
bullets: Analyzed requirements, estimated and executed Waterfall testing across multiple environments for participant and sponsor applications.
Executed Selenium/QTP regression scripts and developed Selenium scripts for the eCompliance application.
